c.tagline: Neon night markets beneath misty green mountains

emergency.note: 112 works from any mobile; the 24-hour tourist hotline 0800-011-765 has English-speaking staff.

hood_landmark.Ximending: the historic Red House Theater amid neon pedestrian shopping streets
hood_landmark.Da'an: Da'an Forest Park, the city's central green lung
hood_landmark.Zhongshan: Xingtian Temple, one of Taipei's busiest shrines
hood_landmark.Shilin: Shilin Night Market, Taipei's biggest night market (with the National Palace Museum nearby)

avoid.reason: Watch belongings in packed night markets like Shilin and Ximending; scams targeting tourists are rare.

hood_desc: Xinyi is Taipei's glossy modern downtown around Taipei 101, full of luxury malls, rooftop bars and nightclubs, ideal for shoppers, nightlife and first-time visitors.
Ximending is a buzzing pedestrian district known as the Harajuku of Taipei, packed with youth fashion, street food and cinemas, great for young and budget travelers.
Da'an is a leafy, upscale residential and university area with Da'an Forest Park, cafes and quiet lanes, well suited to families and longer, relaxed stays.
Zhongshan is a central, sophisticated district blending Japanese-era heritage, department stores and boutique hotels, convenient for business and mid-range travelers.
Shilin is home to Taipei's largest night market and the National Palace Museum, a lively, food-focused area popular with families and first-time sightseers.

water.note: Treated water meets standards but aging pipes mean locals commonly boil or filter it; bottled water is the safer bet for visitors.

transit.pay: Get an EasyCard (NT$100, ~US$3, non-refundable card cost) from MRT station info counters or any 7-Eleven/FamilyMart, and top it up with cash; it works on the MRT, buses, YouBike and even convenience stores. Regular bank cards are not accepted at MRT gates. Single-journey tokens are sold at station machines if you skip the card.
transit.hours: The MRT runs about 6am-midnight daily; night owl buses are limited, so late travel is usually by taxi.

transit.m: Taoyuan Airport MRT Express to Taipei Main Station (36 min)
Kuo-Kuang bus 1819 to Taipei Main Station (60 min)
